From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GTM: Capacity sprint — AE/SE/CS hiring + offer queue prioritization

Team,

We have a narrow window to shore up quota-carrying capacity for the back half of Q4. After syncing with Recruiting and Sales Ops, I'm proposing a short "capacity sprint" to approve and push offers for a prioritized batch of GTM hires we can realistically onboard by Oct 1. Summary below; full breakdown attached (gtm_hiring_sprint_pq.xlsx) and a reference comp band snapshot (comp_bands_q4.pdf).

Ask: approval to (1) reallocate two open IC headcount slots from an under-prioritized mid-market initiative into immediate AE/SE/CS offers, and (2) sign-off on the attached offer bands so Recruiting can extend offers this week.

Priority batch (target 6 hires):
- AE (Enterprise): 2 headcount — focus on two west-coast AE open reqs (GTS-452, GTS-459)
- Solutions Engineer (pre/post sales): 2 headcount — pair with AE hires for coverage
- Customer Success Manager (CSM): 2 headcount — one strategic, one deployment-heavy

Comp guidance (high level):
- AE Enterprise: OTE band $180k–$260k (base + 40% variable) — proposed offers at 85th pct by region for competitiveness
- SE: base-centric bands with target total comp $150k–$200k depending on experience
- CSM: $120k–$165k total comp

Budget impact: net-neutral headcount change (redistribution across mid-market initiative). Compensation uplift for two AE offers will increase the Q4 offer spend by ~$120k cash-flow, but projected ARR contribution from hires (ramped) justifies the spend — see tab 'run-rate model' in the workbook.

Timing: Recruiting can issue offers within 48–72 hours of band approval. Cornerstone Talent is standing by to speed-reference checks for the two AE candidates in process.

If we get sign-off from leadership + finance confirmation on the temporary uplift, I'll coordinate with Legal/People to finalize offer language and get them out by EOD Thursday.

Notes: I'm recommending we earmark one of the two AE offers as an accelerated sign-on (one-time 10% signing bonus) if the candidate requests counter-offers — details in comp_bands_q4.pdf.

Appreciate a quick read and any blockers.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

+1 from me. Great framing Kim. A few tactical suggestions:
- Move one of the CSM reqs to the east coast pay band (candidate pool there is stronger) — see row 18 in the workbook.
- Approve the 10% one-time signing bonus only for AE #1; AE #2 should get normal equity bump.
- Recommend we fast-track background + reference checks via Cornerstone; I pinged Santiago and asked for a 24–36h turnaround (he replied 'can do').

If Finance signs off on the temporary cash flow delta I'm comfortable with the approach. Please send to Laura for final approval and loop in Recruiting to prep offer templates.

—Marissa
